name: claudio
description: Claude Code toolkit: confidence-scored code reviews (PR, local, or full-repo audit), git workflow shortcuts, PR/Slack helpers, Claude meta skills, Jira integration, and per-project knowledge vaults (Karpathy-style LLM Wiki). All skills invocable with no prefix.

phoneUrl.title: Slack drafts phone page
phoneUrl.description: The claude.ai artifact URL of your Slack Drafts phone page. Each saved draft is copied there so you can paste it from your phone. Empty turns it off.

usageBars.title: Usage bars
usageBars.description: Show the context and 5-hour limit bars above the prompt. Off by default, since another plugin's band (a skin, say) may want that spot.

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: Show a small animated pet above the prompt, right of the usage bars: blue while Claude works, green when it's your turn, orange when Claude needs an approval or an answer. Off by default.
